=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md:110-128 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR adds `scripts/evidence_pack.py`, and `agents.d/8427-p4-persist-evidence-pack.md` names that path, but the `## Scripts` section of docs/INVENTORY.md has no entry for `scripts/evidence_pack.py`.
  WHY: CI job tests-release-and-log-analysis on head 4d3c1d8 (run 41185299642, job 124490895106) fails `tests/inventory_parity.py` with "FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/evidence_pack.py" and "FAIL: agents.md:1824: references scripts/evidence_pack.py but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it". This PR caused the failure; it is not inherited. Both reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:95-97,305-307 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `GH_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 2` is passed as `max_attempts` to `gh_api_retry.call` in `Builder.gh` (line 306), so each of the up to 4 logical reads can run `gh api` twice. A build can therefore send up to 8 endpoint requests, against the plan's "at most 4 calls per build".
  WHY: A retryable or rate-limited failure doubles the real request count, while the `calls=4` log line under-reports it. A first-attempt rate limit with wait <= 600 s also sleeps (gh_api_retry.py line 457) before the model runs. The plan path in run_plan_codex.sh has no timeout, so it can stall the planner for up to 600 s. The explicit `max_attempts` also silently overrides `GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS`. Severity is disputed: sonnet, gemini, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR; glm rated it NIT, citing the documented `max_attempts=2 per read` and the repo convention that counts logical calls. The highest severity is used.
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:385-388 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: In the history fetch, `--depth=200` is added only on a shallow repository and `--filter=blob:none` only when `extensions.partialclone` is `origin`, which departs from the plan's exact fetch flags.
  WHY: On a non-partial clone the fetch runs without the `blob:none` filter. This can pull unnecessary history, increase latency and memory use, and departs from the strict P4 plan requirement.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The P4 deliverables and tests listed in the plan are implemented and pass." The inventory-parity contract requires every new `scripts/*` helper referenced in agents.md, fragments included, to have an entry in docs/INVENTORY.md.
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md, `## Scripts` section, between `scripts/attempt_journal.py` (line 127) and `scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py` (line 128)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk in the PR diff or the last-run diff touches docs/INVENTORY.md, and pr_changed_files.txt does not list it. The inventory lists acceptance_check.py (line 112) and attempt_journal.py (line 127) but not evidence_pack.py. CI on 4d3c1d8 (run 41185299642, job 124490895106) reports "FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/evidence_pack.py" and "FAIL: agents.md:1824: references scripts/evidence_pack.py but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it". docs/INVENTORY.md is outside files_touched, but the earlier ci.yml edit set a precedent for that.
- requirement: Keep .github/workflows/* and workflow-templates/* in sync where required.
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The PR modifies .github/workflows/clarify.yml, plan.yml and implement.yml but makes no matching changes to the template workflows in workflow-templates/. Sonnet and glm checked this item and rejected it, because the templates only `uses:` the reusable workflows at `@stable`.
- requirement: "Clarify: repo paths found in the issue body and comments."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/clarify.yml, the issue-comment context passed to scripts/evidence_pack.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The evidence-pack step passes ISSUE_CONTEXT_FILE, which is built from ISSUE_COMMENTS_FILE. That file is limited to the first 50 comments at lines 1043-1046, so paths mentioned only in later comments never reach the evidence pack.
- requirement: "Plan: the same, plus the previous plan's ## Files likely to change when re-planning."
  expected_change_site: scripts/run_plan_codex.sh evidence-pack invocation and scripts/evidence_pack.py path collection
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The plan invocation passes PLANNING_CONTEXT_FILE only as --text-file (lines 359-360). Text-file candidates are accepted only when tracked (scripts/evidence_pack.py lines 262-283), so planned paths for files not yet in the repository are dropped.
- requirement: "git fetch --no-tags --filter=blob:none --depth=200 origin +refs/heads/<default>:refs/persist/history" (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:422)
  expected_change_site: scripts/evidence_pack.py, `Builder.history`, fetch-flag construction (lines 384-388)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Lines 385-388 add --depth=200 only for shallow repositories (line 386) and --filter=blob:none only when extensions.partialclone is origin (line 388), so a full, non-partial clone runs the fetch with neither flag. The deviation is documented as deliberate in the module docstring (line 46) and in the agents fragment's "History fetch" bullet. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md (Scripts section: line 112 lists `scripts/acceptance_check.py` and line 127 lists `scripts/attempt_journal.py`, but there is no `scripts/evidence_pack.py` entry anywhere in the file) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new script and the agents fragment (`agents.d/8427-p4-persist-evidence-pack.md` lines 4-16) are not paired with the inventory entry that the parity checker requires. P1 and P2 each added one.
  WHY: CI tests-release-and-log-analysis on 4d3c1d8 fails `tests/inventory_parity.py` with "FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/evidence_pack.py" and "FAIL: agents.md:1824: references scripts/evidence_pack.py but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it". This PR caused it. The fix is a one-line Scripts entry in alphabetical order.
- scripts/evidence_pack.py (`GH_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 2`; `Builder.gh` → `gh_api_retry.call(..., max_attempts=GH_MAX_ATTEMPTS)`; scripts/gh_api_retry.py line 405, lines 446-457, lines 459-464) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment claims retries cannot stall the stage, but with total=2 a first-attempt rate limit sleeps up to 600 s (line 457), and a transient error sleeps 2-4 s and retries. Two further effects: (a) up to 8 GitHub requests per build, against the plan's "at most 4 calls per build" (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md lines 264, 431); (b) `GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` is silently overridden.
  WHY: scripts/run_plan_codex.sh runs the build inline with `|| true` and no timeout (plan.yml line 1943, job timeout 120). One rate-limited response therefore blocks the planner for up to 600 s. In clarify.yml and implement.yml a `timeout-minutes: 5` kill means no pack is produced. Suggested fix: `GH_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 1`, plus updates to the test and the fragment text.
- TASK_GAP | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  Requirement: "The P4 deliverables and tests listed in the plan are implemented and pass." The inventory parity contract requires every new `scripts/*` helper named in agents.md to appear in docs/INVENTORY.md.
  Expected change site: docs/INVENTORY.md, `## Scripts` section, an entry for `scripts/evidence_pack.py`
  Evidence of absence: No PR or last-run hunk touches docs/INVENTORY.md, and pr_changed_files.txt does not list it. CI on 4d3c1d8 reports "Scripts: missing scripts/evidence_pack.py".
- HARDENING (risk score 2): scripts/run_plan_codex.sh, `python3 -B scripts/evidence_pack.py build ...` line: the plan-path build has no wall-clock bound. Suggested fix: prefix it with `timeout 300` and keep `|| true` (1 line).
- Rejected pass-1 items: the workflow-templates sync gap (gemini), because templates only `uses:` the reusable workflows at @stable and the switches are read from `vars.*`; the fetch-flag deviation (luna), because it is deliberate, documented and safer.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

- scripts/evidence_pack.py:line 97 (GH_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 2) and line 306 (gh_api_retry.call(..., max_attempts=GH_MAX_ATTEMPTS)); cross-checked against scripts/gh_api_retry.py:392-466 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The build makes 4 helper invocations (1 pulls, up to 2 GraphQL, 1 actions/runs). Each allows 2 attempts (`while attempt <= total:` at scripts/gh_api_retry.py:419), so the worst case is 8 requests against the plan's "API: at most 4 calls per build". The agents.d fragment documents `max_attempts=2 per read`.
  WHY: When any read hits a transient or secondary rate-limit failure, it retries once. If all four reads fail once, the build uses 8 requests from the GitHub API quota instead of 4.
